mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310.0) signals a risk of aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 310.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0), tight labor market conditions support wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the average return in this regime is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 102.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals immediate consumer spending strength and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that supports wage growth and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past quarter signals strong consumer demand and economic resilience, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
